title: The Lost One's Camp
text: A cold camp lies under an overhang: a bedroll, a fire long out, a single bowl licked clean. A journal lies open on the stones, its pages warped with damp, the writing in a Scion's hand. The last entry stops halfway through a word.

options.label: The wisest reads the journal, to learn what became of them.

outcomes.text: It tells of their last days, where they went and what they heard at night. The fear in the unfinished word stays with you.

options.label: The best tracker follows them from here before the trail goes cold.

outcomes.text: The trail is fresh enough; they might still be alive.

options.label: Rest here as they did, and hope your night goes better.

outcomes.text: The fire takes and nothing comes in the night. Nothing came for them either, at first.
